name: New Jersey Wire Cloth Company
old_description: Serving clientele of many industries, we ship worldwide with great lead times, large in-house inventory, as well as rush and emergency services. All of our products are backed by 100% guarantee.
about:
New Jersey Wire Cloth Company, Inc. was founded in 1962 in Cedar Grove, New Jersey. The business remains family-run, though the founders are not named in public materials. It began as a manufacturer of wire and plastic mesh screen belts for industrial applications.

The company produces a range of wire and plastic mesh belt products, including absorbent product belts, food product belts, and custom screen belts for non-woven, packing, and circular applications. Operations are housed in a manufacturing warehouse and office facility in Cedar Grove, where the firm maintains a large in-house inventory and offers emergency or rush production services with worldwide shipping. Specific headcount, facility size, and annual volume figures are not disclosed.

Primary customers operate in the commercial food, absorbent products, and laundry industries, though the company notes it serves clientele across many sectors. Examples include custom belts for food processing lines, absorbent product manufacturing, and laundry equipment.

The company emphasizes old-school customer service, answering all calls and emails directly and providing fast request-for-quote and purchase-order lead times. It backs all products with a 100% satisfaction guarantee and positions its depth of services and over six decades of experience as key differentiators for solving manufacturing downtime issues.
